premises.text: People default to familiar places because trying somewhere new feels risky
premises.evidence_span: we don't want to take the chance and try to go to a new place because we're not sure that we're going to like the experience

premises.text: SpotOn personalizes place recommendations from Facebook and Foursquare social network data
premises.evidence_span: pulling in your existing social network data from Facebook and Foursquare, uses it to build a profile of you to give you personalized and actionable recommendations

premises.text: Friend ratings and who-to-go-with cues provide trusted social reasons to try a place
premises.evidence_span: when I see that my coffee lover friend has rated a place four out of four, that means a lot more to me than if a completely random person had rated the place the same exact rating

premises.text: User-contributed ratings in SpotOn improve everyone's recommendations via a new shared information layer
premises.evidence_span: Every piece of data that I contribute to SpotOn adds to this entirely new layer of information that did not exist before

domains.name: Social graph personalization and contribution loop

value.text: Change how friends come together in the physical world by getting them to great shared experiences
value.evidence_span: it's changing the way that friends come together in the physical world

secondary_value.text: Easiest way to go to new places with friends
secondary_value.evidence_span: SpotOn is the easiest way to go to new places with your friends

causal_links.evidence_span: try to go to a new place
